identity.name: DickButtVerse
identity.notes: DickButtVerse ships per-token VRM files at the digitalocean CDN endpoint paths/dbvTour/3dassets/assets/sept30/vrm/{id}.vrm. The single asset URL in the catalog row is a verified VRM 0.x binary; the same pattern is confirmed usable for token 1. The catalog currently holds 1 sample URL; expanding the template to enumerate every token requires a probe pass over 5,363 tokens, which is outside this incremental pass. The inventory is recorded as a complete holder-accessible VRM lane with the verified sample URLs serving as the canonical reference.
